lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gills, arranged in three primary horizontal rows. The centroids in the medial row exhibit higher pixel intensity and diameter compared to the dorsal and ventral rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the spot centroids, forming a discernible rectilinear grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high pixel values on the superior edge and a deep shadow gradient on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately six distinct high-luminance spots, primarily clustered along the proximal leading edge and central surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral region near the pectoral fin and trailing below the midsection.
